$comment: `detail` is the two-witness case that got it promoted out of providerOptions: OpenAI spells
it image_url.detail, Gemini spells it per-Part mediaResolution.level, and both mean the same
thing — how many tokens this attachment costs. Both encoders used to DROP it with a
dropped_param naming the other dialect as having no equivalent, which was two warnings
asserting a gap that did not exist.
Only two dialects are present, and that is the case rather than an omission: /v1/messages
sizes images by pixel dimensions and has no per-attachment hint at all. The anthropic arm
is the lossy-image-detail fixture next door.
